name: item.blowgun.name
editNote: Accepted: the book's Simple Weapons table (p.281) prints Blowgun's damage as a flat '1 P' with no die -- a genuinely non-dice damage value (the weapon's real role is a nonlethal, agile delivery method for injury poisons, not a damage dealer). The schema's damage.dice pattern only accepts NdX dice notation, so it cannot represent a flat value; recorded as a gap rather than fabricating a die that would change the weapon's actual damage output. Critical Specialization Effects (dart group) is the same recorded per-group omission accepted for other weapons.
